authority.note: A source empowered to decide a fact; do not translate as access permission.

binding.note: Composition-time association between a requirement and an exact provider identity.

fail-closed.note: Keep the technical token when ambiguity would change safety semantics.

provider.note: Keep as a technical role when referring to a platform provider contract.

projection.note: A derived/read representation that must not silently become authority.

reconciliation.note: Evidence-driven resolution of an uncertain external effect.

identity.note: Use the platform identity meaning, not personal identity.
